error.anal.abundance: Engine error for the formula analysis; {label} = the element symbol with no natural abundances in the table.
error.grafo.cut.mode: Engine error message; {mode} = type of cleavage requested.
err.http: Network error without details; {status} = HTTP code.
error.fixedLimit: A fixed limit of the program (not memory): {what} = the part of the file, English words from the engine; {limit_mb} = the limit in MB.
err.engine.indexWhy: The index of a file could not be built. {name} = file name, {detail} = technical cause.
err.engine.indexCrash: The worker that builds the index died (usually memory). {name} = file name.
err.engine.indexCrash.native: The command line and the app variant of the previous key: the process that builds the index died (usually memory). {name} = file name.
err.dam.unreadable: Shown in the method window; {message} = technical text (English).
err.map.region: Map API error: region with inverted ends.
err.formula.element: {element} = symbol, {formula} = formula written by the user.
err.compare.input: Engine error message; {detail} = the file and why it cannot be read.
err.compare.overlap: Engine error message; {detail} = the columns in both the reference and the blank.
err.compare.param: Engine error message; {detail} = the setting that is wrong.
err.compare.quantity: Engine error message shown when the height is asked of a CSV table, which carries areas only.
err.compare.samples: Engine error message; {detail} = the selector that needs the samples file.
err.compare.selector: Engine error message; {detail} = the selector and the columns of the table.
err.comp.many: {n} = number of combinations of the elements other than C and H; {max} = fixed limit (3000000). Error for a single m/z: the other features go on.
err.load.cancelled: The loading of a file was stopped with "Cancel" (the file row already says so: the text does not repeat the name).
warn.mzrun.roleSha: CLI flow record notice on stderr. {file} = a file name in the roles file with an empty sha256, {sha256} = the SHA-256 of the run input of that name that was used.
warn.convert.fewerWorkers: Calm conversion notice (CLI and desktop app queue): the memory budget allows fewer simultaneous conversions. {workers} = simultaneous conversions, {wanted} = the default ones (cores-1, max 4), {budget_mb} = computer budget in MB.
err.conv.mzlabNoProfile: Error of convert with peaks = mzlab (CLI, app) on a file that has only the vendor centroids: mzLab does not write the instrument centroids as its own.
warn.centroid.widthFallback: Warning of the spectra.centroid step (Flow, CLI and site): the width is not measured but a fallback; never call it estimated.
warn.centroid.merged: Warning of the spectra.centroid step (Flow, CLI and site): centroids with the MERGED flag (full width at half maximum over 1.12 times that of the file at their m/z); a warning, not an answer.
note.features.centroided: Note of the features command and of estimates/1 (terminal and Flow): the profile scans of a unit-resolution file were centroided before detection; {profile} = MS1 scans in profile mode, {scans} = MS1 scans. Calm, nothing to fix.
warn.features.profileUnit: Warning of the features command (terminal): the first file is profile mode at unit resolution; {profile} = MS1 scans in profile mode, {scans} = MS1 scans.
warn.agilent.damaged: Calm partial-read notice (CLI, flow, loading row): damaged scan records of an Agilent .D folder (without time, points outside the data file, data.ms records that do not fit): their scans are left out and counted. Do not say that the file ends.
warn.bruker.noCalibration: Calm partial-read notice (CLI, flow, loading row): frames of a .d folder without a usable MzCalibration; their spectra are left out and counted because their m/z cannot be calculated. Do not say that the file ends.
error.featMemory: Tabui (pipeline) error: a stage does not fit in memory. {fase} = stage (align, proofs), {files} = number of files, {stima_mb} and {budget_mb} = estimated memory and budget in MB.
error.copyRanges: Error: the byte ranges of a partial copy are not ascending, not whole numbers or not inside the file. {file} = file name.
error.fileInUse: Error: the file has been written by another mzLab tab for more than 2 seconds. {file} = file name.
err.manint.columns: Error of the manual integrations table for an unknown optional column group; {column} = name requested.
err.manint.baseline: Error of the manual integrations table for an unknown baseline; {baseline} = name requested.
err.sample.list: Error message of --sample and the site's sample selection; {text} = the text given.
err.sample.unknown: Error message of --sample and the site's sample selection; {missing} = requested sample ids not in the file, {ids} = the sample ids the file has.
err.sample.single: Error message of --sample of the convert CLI when no input has several samples.
meta.missing: Entry of method/1.warnings: an expected part that the file does not have (log, method). {place} = the part.
meta.damaged: Warning of the method/1 document: an auxiliary table (metadata, TIMS calibration, method properties) is damaged; {place} = file and table. The scans are read.
meta.ionDiscarded: Entry of method/1.warnings of the .raw: the monoisotopic ion of the trailer falls outside the isolation window and the target is used. {place} = count of the scans, text from the reader.
meta.fromTable: Entry of method/1.warnings of the .raw: a value taken from the method (SRM transitions table) and not from the individual scan. {place} = what and how many scans, text from the reader.
err.formula.offset: Engine error message; {offset} = the offset written by the user, with its sign.
err.formula.mzLow: Engine error message; {mz} = m/z (below 1) that would give the offset written.
error.check.tooBig: Drawing check error; {max} = maximum number of atoms.
error.cip.tooComplex: CIP descriptors refused (Draw card, mol cip, exit 1); {atoms} = atoms of the structure, {elements} = its defined stereo elements, {work} = steps it took, {limit} = steps allowed (params also carry stage: sites or labels against the work limit, digraph against the node cap of one label).
error.descr.molfile: Error of the molecular descriptors of the drawing (mol measure); {detail} = what the molfile reader could not read.
error.descr.tooBig: Error of the molecular descriptors of the drawing (mol measure); {max} = maximum number of atoms.
error.drift.tooFewQc: Engine error message; {batch} = batch, {have} = how many there are, {need} = how many are needed.
error.open.tooBig: Engine error when a structure file dropped on the Drawing tab is too large; {size} = the file size in bytes, or "more than N" when the input has no known size (standard input), {limit} = the largest size opened, in bytes.
error.label.element: Engine error message (drawing labels); {label} = atom label in Ketcher.
error.label.isotope: Engine error message (drawing labels); {label} = atom symbol with the isotope.
error.hilite.query: Evidence colors error: the structure (SMILES or substructure) cannot be read or compared with the drawing; {detail} = technical detail from the reader (e.g. "empty").
error.hypo.rulesVersion: Engine error message; {found} = version found, {need} = how many are needed.
error.generic: Error without its own text; {detail} = technical message from the engine.
error.generic.native: The command line and the app variant of the previous key; {detail} = technical message from the engine.
err.cli.usage: Engine error message of a command line the CLI cannot use; {message} = what is wrong.
err.cli.file: CLI error: a file cannot be read; {path} = the file.
err.msn.rules.document: CLI error: a file given to msn rules sum is not an msn-rules/1 document; {path} = the file.
err.mol.draw.request: Error of mol draw; the request has no usable spec.
err.mol.draw.binary: Error of mol draw: the text form of the answer was asked for a PNG, which is bytes.
err.mol.draw.element: Error of mol draw; {symbol} = the atom label that is no element.
err.mol.draw.set: Error of mol draw; {name} = the setting (format, file, layout, scale, cip, highlight), {value} = the value given.
err.mol.draw.smiles: Error of mol draw; {message} = technical text from the SMILES reader.
err.mol.draw.molfile: Error of mol draw; {message} = technical text from the molfile reader.
err.mol.draw.needDb: Error of mol draw; {kind} = name or InChIKey; --set db is a command-line option, keep it as written.
err.mol.draw.inchi: Error of mol draw; InChI and InChIKey are chemistry terms.
err.mol.draw.db: Error of mol draw; {message} = why the molecules CSV was not used: the file is too large or not UTF-8 text, or the CSV lacks the columns name and smiles.
err.mol.draw.not_found: Error of mol draw; {spec} = the name looked for, {nearest} = up to three nearest names (this text is used only when there are some).
err.mol.draw.not_found_bare: Error of mol draw; {spec} = the name or InChIKey looked for; nothing near it in the database.
err.mol.draw.tooBig: Error of mol draw; {max} = maximum number of atoms.
err.mol.draw.edit: Error of mol draw --set edit; {index} = 0-based index of the failing operation, {op} = its name, {reason} = the reason key, {detail} = what is wrong.
err.mol.draw.editJson: Error of mol draw --set edit; {message} = why the patch text cannot be read as JSON.
err.cli.design.samplesAndFiles: CLI usage error of sample design propose: both --samples and FILE paths were given.
err.cli.design.needsInput: CLI usage error of sample design; {op} = the operation (propose).
err.cli.design.oneFile: CLI usage error of sample design; {op} = the operation (validate or canonical).
err.cli.design.unknownOp: CLI usage error of sample design; {op} = the word given.
err.cli.format.csvNotUvAuto: CLI usage error of trace: --format csv was asked for the uv:auto band.
err.cli.out: CLI error: an output cannot be written; {path} = the path.
err.cli.input.missing: CLI error of flow run: an input of the plan was not found; {input} = its name.
err.cli.command.unknown: CLI error of commands: no command has this path; {path} = the words given.
err.cli.find.none: CLI error of commands --find: no command or step matches the task words; {words} = the search words kept.
err.cli.command.renamed: CLI usage error: the first word is the name an earlier build gave a command; {old} = that word, {now} = the command path it has now.
err.cli.command.removed: CLI usage error: the first word names a command that no longer exists; {old} = that word, {why} = what it belonged to.
err.run.internal: CLI error: the program panicked and answered before it stopped; {detail} = the panic message and its source position, cut to 300 characters.
err.cli.schema.unknown: CLI error of schema: no embedded schema has this name; {name} = the name given.
err.cli.input.twice: CLI error of flow run: an input was given more than once; {input} = its name.
err.design.problem.badKind: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.badNumber: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.duplicate: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.missing: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.notJson: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.refMissing: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.unknownCondition: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.wrongSchema: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.wrongType: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file.
err.design.problem.emptyComparison: Design check message; {key} = path of the bad key in the design file, {condition} = condition without sample files.
err.design.hint: Hint under a design that is not valid.
err.design.why.allAgainstReference: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1.
err.design.why.containsControl: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1; {name} = the condition chosen as reference.
err.design.why.containsNoGas: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1; {name} = the condition chosen as reference.
err.design.why.containsReference: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1; {name} = the condition chosen as reference.
err.design.why.defaultBatch: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1.
err.design.why.given: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1; {name} = the reference condition.
err.design.why.noReference: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1.
err.design.why.nothingToCompare: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1.
err.design.why.prefixRef: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1; {name} = the condition chosen as reference.
err.design.why.series: Design proposal reason, a sentence in the `reason` of a choice of design_proposal/1.
err.design.samplesNotJson: Design check message; {path} = the samples file given with --samples.
err.design.invalid: Design check message; {count} = number of problems, {key} = path of the first bad key.
err.mz.offset.spec: Usage error of the --mz-offset flag of trace xic and features, and of mzoff= on api/xic: not a number or auto:MZ[@RT]. {text} = what was given.
err.mz.offset.range: Usage error of --mz-offset: a fixed offset above 0.6 Da in size. {da} = the number given.
warn.mz.offset.notFound: Warning on stderr of trace xic and features with --mz-offset auto: the known ion gave no peak 3 times above the median of its XIC, so the offset is 0.
warn.mz.offset.wide: Warning on stderr of trace xic and features with --mz-offset auto: the centroids of the known ion spread by more than 0.15 Da (their median absolute deviation); the offset is still applied.
